verdict.rationale: ADP's own RUN page says the product lets you 'pay employees and contractors' with taxes handled. ADP also creates and e-files both W-2 and 1099 forms, an additional-fee service, which places W-2 and 1099 workers on the same platform. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the contractor payment workflow (onboarding, payment methods for 1099 workers), 1099 filing included in base price rather than as an add-on, independent or hands-on corroboration.
